db:select.doc:name: Check application exists
db:select.db:sql: SELECT application_id FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId

db:insert.doc:name: Upsert document
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO application_documents (application_id, doc_type, file_name, status, reason, size_bytes, sha256, source_path, stored_path) VALUES (:applicationId, :docType, :fileName, :status, :reason, :sizeBytes, :sha256, :sourcePath, :storedPath) ON CONFLICT (application_id, source_path) DO UPDATE SET doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type, file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name, status = EXCLUDED.status, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, sha256 = EXCLUDED.sha256, stored_path = EXCLUDED.stored_path
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ applicationId: vars.applicationId, docType: payload.docType, fileName: payload.fileName, status: payload.status, reason: payload.reason, sizeBytes: payload.sizeBytes, sha256: payload.sha256, sourcePath: payload.sourcePath, storedPath: payload.storedPath }]

set-variable.value: Document inventory conflicts with existing records
set-variable.doc:name: Set appErrorMessage

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { applicationId: vars.applicationId, documents: sizeOf(vars.documents) }

db:select.doc:name: Insert decision
db:select.db:sql: WITH d AS ( INSERT INTO credit_decisions (application_id, decision, score, scorecard_version, deciding_rule, reason_codes, requested_amount, approved_amount, approved_tenure, approved_rate_pct, instalment, affordability_ratio, reduction_reason, offer_expires_at) SELECT a.application_id, CAST(:decision AS text), CAST(:score AS numeric), CAST(:scorecardVersion AS text), CAST(:decidingRule AS text), string_to_array(CAST(:reasonCodes AS text), ','), CAST(:requestedAmount AS numeric), CAST(:approvedAmount AS numeric), CAST(:approvedTenure AS integer), CAST(:approvedRatePct AS numeric), CAST(:instalment AS numeric), CAST(:affordabilityRatio AS numeric), CAST(:reductionReason AS text), CAST(CAST(:offerExpiresAt AS text) AS timestamptz) FROM applications a WHERE a.application_id = :applicationId AND a.stage = 'SCORING' ON CONFLICT (application_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING application_id ), upd AS ( UPDATE applications a SET stage = CAST(:decision AS text), stage_reason = CAST(:decidingRule AS text), updated_at = now() FROM d WHERE a.application_id = d.application_id RETURNING a.application_id ), au AS ( INSERT INTO decision_audit (application_id, correlation_id, event, from_stage, to_stage, source_app) SELECT upd.application_id, CAST(:correlationId AS uuid), CAST(:decision AS text), 'SCORING', CAST(:decision AS text), CAST(:sourceApp AS text) FROM upd ), ob AS ( INSERT INTO outbox (id, queue_name, payload) SELECT CAST(:messageId AS uuid), 'loan.decision.q', jsonb_build_object('messageId', CAST(:messageId AS text), 'correlationId', CAST(:correlationId AS text), 'applicationId', upd.application_id, 'type', 'DECISION_READY', 'attempt', 1, 'createdAt', CAST(:createdAt AS text)) FROM upd ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS inserted, (SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId) AS found, (SELECT stage FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId) AS current_stage, (SELECT count(*) FROM credit_decisions WHERE application_id = :applicationId) AS decision_count
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ applicationId: vars.applicationId, decision: payload.decision, score: payload.score, scorecardVersion: payload.scorecardVersion, decidingRule: payload.decidingRule, reasonCodes: (payload.reasonCodes default []) joinBy ",", requestedAmount: payload.requestedAmount, approvedAmount: payload.approvedAmount, approvedTenure: payload.approvedTenure, approvedRatePct: payload.approvedRatePct, instalment: payload.instalment, affordabilityRatio: payload.affordabilityRatio, reductionReason: payload.reductionReason, offerExpiresAt: payload.offerExpiresAt, correlationId: payload.correlationId, sourceApp: payload.sourceApp, messageId: uuid(), createdAt: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"} }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert rule hit
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO decision_rule_hits (application_id, rule_code, rule_type, input_value, weight, points, contribution, triggered) VALUES (:applicationId, :ruleCode, :ruleType, :inputValue, :weight, :points, :contribution, :triggered)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ applicationId: vars.applicationId, ruleCode: payload.ruleCode, ruleType: payload.ruleType, inputValue: payload.inputValue, weight: payload.weight, points: payload.points, contribution: payload.contribution, triggered: payload.triggered }]

set-variable.value: #['Application is in stage ' ++ vars.result.current_stage ++ ', not SCORING']
set-variable.doc:name: Set appErrorMessage

logger.message: #['decision saved applicationId=' ++ vars.applicationId ++ ' created=' ++ (vars.created as String) ++ ' correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { applicationId: vars.applicationId, created: vars.created }
